aggregation: Rate each of the five dimensions once over the complete conversation, 0 to 4; total out of 20, normalized to 100. Include turn-specific evidence and limitations. No readiness percentage or broad accuracy estimate.

assessment_dimensions.context_and_corrections: Uses prior turns and incorporates explicit corrections.
assessment_dimensions.instruction_following: Preserves requested format, quantities and style.
assessment_dimensions.relevance: Answers the actual request rather than unrelated continuation.
assessment_dimensions.understanding: Understands the English request and intended task.

authorization: After each completed training iteration, conduct an actual conversation, assess directly, then advance based on failures.
checkpoint_policy: Require the selected terminal continuation checkpoint and bound terminal diagnostic receipt. Assess even if its NLL smoke fails. Never substitute a partial checkpoint or repaired model replies.
comparison_limitations: Same first prompt, budget and five-dimension anchors as iteration one. Adaptive later turns need not match; compare overlapping tasks explicitly, not as independent benchmark accuracy.
creator: Navneet Prabhakar
execution: Do not run concurrently with student training or loss scoring. Preserve exact user/assistant history and raw token IDs; no truncation, teacher, retrieval, tools, repair or fallback. Grade only after reading all actual replies.
followup_policy: Choose follow-ups after inspecting each actual response. Exercise clarification, correction, memory, simple quantities and style. Retain the exact generated assistant history, including mistakes; never replace it with ideal replies.
initial_prompt: Hi! My name is Mira. Please say hello to me in one short sentence.
scope: Actual operator-led second-iteration development conversation after terminal training and scored loss diagnostics; not a blinded benchmark.

score_anchors.0: No demonstrated success; unrelated output, incoherent fragments or ignored requirements.
score_anchors.1: Isolated relevant fragments or limited success, with dominant failures.
score_anchors.2: Partial success with substantial omissions or errors.
score_anchors.4: Consistently succeeds across applicable conversation turns.

training_use: Development conversation only. Not admitted for training; future use requires source/lineage and split review.
